name: Trouble Fortune Company★Happy Cure
original_name: とらぶるふぉうちゅんCOMPANY★はぴCURE
source:
The story is about our protagonist Tsuzuri whose mother is a fortune teller. One day her mom Sakura goes missing in action, leaving Tsuzuri and her brother Amane, saying she’s gone to look for their father. She leaves without saying where she’s going and how long she’ll be gone and now all of her fortune telling customers demand to see her. It’s up to Tsuzuri to train (aka for you to raise stats) so that she can become a super fortune teller and snag that man.

[From [url=http://breadmasterlee.wordpress.com/2011/01/31/otome-game-review-trouble-fortune-company-happy%E2%98%86cure/]Hanano's Game Babbles[/url]]
translation:
故事的主角是綴，她的母親是一名占卜師。一天，母親櫻突然失蹤，只告訴綴和她的哥哥天音，自己要去尋找他們的父親。她沒有說明去哪裡，也沒說會離開多久，所有前來占卜的顧客卻都堅持要見她。綴只得展開修行（也就是由玩家培養能力值），努力成為一名超級占卜師，並把心儀的男人追到手。

[出自[url=http://breadmasterlee.wordpress.com/2011/01/31/otome-game-review-trouble-fortune-company-happy%E2%98%86cure/]Hanano's Game Babbles[/url]]
